Melissa is already here, but I can’t see Annalie anywhere.
Bot: Hey Melissa, how have you been?
Melissa: Alright. Work’s been easy for these past few days. I was even able to take more overtime than usual.
Melissa really doesn’t seem to have many things to talk about aside from work…
Bot: Good for you!
Bot: What are you going to buy yourself with all that overtime money?
#Cashier.Face.shocked
Melissa: Buy myself something? That’s not really an option since-
#Cashier.Face.normal
